mapper.sql: u.id AS id, u.username AS username, u.real_name AS realName, u.dept_id AS deptId, d.dept_name AS deptName, u.phone AS phone, u.email AS email, u.status AS status, u.last_login_at AS lastLoginAt, u.created_at AS createdAt, u.is_deleted AS isDeleted, u.deleted_at AS deletedAt, u.deleted_by AS deletedBy
FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_department d ON d.id = u.dept_id

SELECT id, username, password, real_name, dept_id, phone, email, status, must_change_password AS mustChangePassword, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted AS isDeleted, deleted_at AS deletedAt, deleted_by AS deletedBy FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, username, password, real_name, dept_id, phone, email, status, must_change_password AS mustChangePassword, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted AS isDeleted, deleted_at AS deletedAt, deleted_by AS deletedBy FROM sys_user WHERE id IN
#{id}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE r.role_code = #{roleCode} AND u.status = 1 AND u.is_deleted = 0 AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND ur.is_deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE r.role_code = 'ADMIN' AND u.status = 1 AND u.id <> #{excludeUserId} AND u.is_deleted = 0 AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND ur.is_deleted = 0
SELECT ur.role_id FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.is_deleted = 0 AND r.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY ur.role_id ASC
SELECT DISTINCT ur.user_id FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE r.role_code = #{roleCode} AND ur.is_deleted = 0 AND r.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY ur.user_id ASC

SELECT id, username, password, real_name, dept_id, phone, email, status, must_change_password AS mustChangePassword, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted AS isDeleted, deleted_at AS deletedAt, deleted_by AS deletedBy FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT DISTINCT r.role_code FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 AND ur.is_deleted = 0 AND r.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.role_code ASC

SELECT DISTINCT p.perm_code FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id INNER JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.is_deleted = 0 AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND rp.is_deleted = 0 AND p.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.perm_code ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET last_login_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (username, password, real_name, dept_id, phone, email, status, must_change_password) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{realName}, #{deptId}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{status}, #{mustChangePassword})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{expectedStatus}

INSERT INTO sys_user_role (user_id, role_id, is_deleted) VALUES
(#{userId}, #{roleId}, 0)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_deleted = 0, deleted_at = NULL, deleted_by = 'DB'
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id SET ur.is_deleted = 1, ur.deleted_at = NOW(6), ur.deleted_by = COALESCE(#{operatorId}, 'DB') WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.role_code = #{roleCode} AND ur.is_deleted = 0
UPDATE sys_user SET is_deleted = 1, deleted_at = NOW(6), deleted_by = COALESCE(#{operatorId}, 'DB') WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE sys_user SET is_deleted = 0, deleted_at = NULL, deleted_by = 'DB' WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 1
